parsed.rationale: All five members are type-alias-objects with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural pipeline detected shape similarity solely on the basis of being empty-bodied type aliases — not on shared field content. The aliases serve distinct domain roles: `Discogs.Release.Label`, `Discogs.Release.ReleaseArtist`, and `Discogs.Master.ReleaseArtist` are Discogs API response model aliases in `Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift`, while `Release` and `Artist` in `Shared/Metadata/Sources/Metadata/_Plant_ReleaseRepository.swift` and `_Plant_ArtistRepository.swift` are local convenience aliases in the Metadata package. The `_Plant_` prefix on the Metadata files suggests these are scaffolded/planted stubs that are intentionally local to their repository files. Merging these aliases would conflate Discogs API surface types with Metadata domain types across two separate packages (`Artwork` and `Metadata`), creating an inappropriate coupling with no real deduplication benefit.
